question: If ₹5000 amounts to ₹6050 over 2 years with compound interest, what is the annual interest rate?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Amount to Principal = 6050 / 5000 = 121 / 100

For 2 years compound interest, the multiplying factor is the square root of the ratio.

⇒ Multiplying factor per year = √(121 / 100) = 11 / 10

⇒ Annual Interest Rate = (11 − 10) / 10 × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**
